stories.text: Cost of living protests in Germany turn violent, with shops looted in Frankfurt and unrest reported in Berlin, Hamburg and Cologne.
Chancellor Healey suggests younger workers may not get the same minimum wage as others before the next election, risking a broken promise.
Ukrainians evacuated from the Russian-occupied front-line city of Oleshky describe crossing minefields to search for food during years under occupation.
Former chancellor Rachel Reeves says the UK's future lies inside the EU, arguing Brexit has left the country poorer, weaker and less secure.
Industry experts tip certain Celebrity Traitors contestants to enjoy the biggest career boost now that the show has ended.
Supermodel and TV host Heidi Klum dresses as a giant severed hand for her annual Halloween party in New York.
Lewis Hamilton claims his first pole for Ferrari, and his first in over three years, at the Mexico City Grand Prix.
New Airbnb rules taking effect in November bar hosts from asking guests to do the washing up or take out the bins.
Sri Lankan Ruchira Ranasingha, 50, has been stranded in the Cook Islands since 2023, unable to get a transit visa to fly home.
Aleksandar Vucic's election defeat in Serbia last weekend closely mirrored the fall of Viktor Orban in Hungary, analysis suggests.
